name: Nest Wisdom Vault
oneLiner: nWISDOM is Nest's NAV-priced vault; its feed includes material nUSDR receivable exposure with undisclosed economic terms.
collateral: Nest's exact positions feed identifies nUSDR at Plume 0x9f7c9b376db048720671b93d5258f75c66653225, stablecoin balances, nTBILL and a near-zero xCRDYX position. The nUSDR token name is Nest USD Receivable, but its legal obligor, enforceable claim, maturity and realization terms are not established by the public disclosures; it is not classified as cash or a stablecoin merely because the API lists it under liquidAssets.
pegMechanism: Vault LP token whose value follows the Nest strategy NAV, including underlying fund and receivable valuations; primary mint and redemption occur through Nest at NAV using route-specific supported stablecoins

notices.title: NAV-style dollar asset
notices.message: nWISDOM is a Nest vault share whose value tracks the underlying WisdomTree fund book. It behaves like a vault share rather than a hard 1:1 par stablecoin.
